notes.title: Who you gonna call? Bug Squishers!
notes.content:
[h1][u][b][i]Lost Legend --- Patch Notes 1.7.8[/i][/b][/u][/h1]

Hello everyone and welcome to the first official patch notes for Lost Legends! I (Elijah) will be compiling all the changes made to the game (starting with this version) and making patch notes so everyone knows what is updated, changed, or removed from the game as we release updates. This update will focus on some bug fixing and QoL improvements.

[i]Icon Updates:[/i]
-Small Gemstone
-Large Gemstone

[i]General Fixes:[/i]
-Fixed up cut-scenes
-Cleaned up some visuals to the maps

[i]Tutoria:[/i]
-Fixed directions for Joshua
-You can now rescue Sarah without starting the quest first

[i]Dawnfall:[/i]
-City visuals updated
-Winery updated
-House #3 added

[i]Chephren:[/i]
-There is now a health check before fighting with Dexter the second time
-Dexter now uses alchemy in all fights
-Innkeeper now give the correctly numbered keys

[i]Kastburg:[/i]
-The quest “Find Quinn” ending now works
-You can now complete the Shopping list quest without buying any of the items. They can be found around the city (you can still buy them).

[i]Fast Travel Update:[/i]
The fast travel system is getting an upgrade. We have decided to give the mailboxes in the game some functionality and we are linking it to the fast travel system. They way it will work is that you can send letters to Captain Wiley in order to change his location. That way, if you are in a city that he is not at yet, you can have him move. Here is what we have so far.
-Added event for mailboxes
-Connected to Captain Wiley event

notes.title: SPRING CLEANING UPDATE GOING LIVE!
notes.content:
As promised a week-or-so ago, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/about]we're[/url] rolling out an update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend]Lost Legend[/url]. We've been working a lot on adding more to the story. It's been a long time since we've pushed an update, but that's because there's been a lot of stuff we've done that the player couldn't access yet. Now, the main story should have a lot more progression. 

Some music files have been changed to sound better, and a soundtrack will hopefully be available on the 28th of March! Mark your calendar! 

Some grammatical issues have been fixed. Some game-breaking bugs have been fixed. 

As [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] said before, thank you for your continued support in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend]Lost Legend[/url] and in [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com]Unhinged LLC[/url]. We will post another update soon!

Thanks,

-  [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]Adam[/url] and  [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url]

notes.title: Spring Cleaning Update
notes.content:
Although not everything is reachable by the player yet, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] have been working hard to add content to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]Lost Legend[/url]. [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/ryan]Ryan Wiley[/url] has done some more voice acting, and our friend [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/elijah]Elijah[/url] has done some icon images. Despite having full-time jobs, we're trying to get this game finished.

You'll notice the library and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]store pages[/url] now have more up-to-date artwork. The screenshots we had on the store page were quite old, and the library image was a screenshot from a scene that had very little to do with the overall game. Now, more characters are represented, and Alchemy as a whole is now also represented. Also on the  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]store page[/url] you may notice that we [i]kindof[/i] have a release date posted. [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] hope to have the game finished by the end of 2022... or, at least hopefully the beginning of 2023. As [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] mentioned earlier, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] work full-time jobs. We're each 25, we each just purchased a house, and we are each doing other things that people in their 20s do while starting their independent lives. We hope you guys understand. 

We thank you for continuing to support [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]Lost Legend[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com]Unhinged LLC[/url], and we hope to post another update soon with an actual game build update to go along with it. 

Until then. 

- [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]Adam[/url]

notes.title: LOST LEGEND DEV STREAM
notes.content:
[url=www.twitch.tv/unhinged_]WATCH THE STREAM HERE![/url]

[h1=top]About the Stream[/h1]
Brandon and Adam have never made a video game before: this is their first one. They're also in the busiest time of their lives: their mid-twenties! [i]Ouch![/i] That means finding time to develop a video game is hard. That's why the two set aside Tuesday evenings to work on their game. Every Tuesday night, Adam, Brandon, and their friends stream on Twitch to ensure [i]something[/i] gets done on the game. 

[h1]About the Game[/h1]
The people of Alcomby once lived in peace. People with the power to transmute matter, called Alchemists, rose to power and reigned peacefully. Then, the world changed when people without these special powers fought back. With the help of The Church, Alchemists were forced to take part in The Great War to save their lineage and keep their rule. Unfortunately, outnumbered, the Alchemists' reign ended, and The Church took control over the land of Alcomby. Now, in these post-war times, The Church is looking to eradicate the Alchemists once and for all.

You, having experienced the war first-hand, are an orphan. Your parents were killed by Alchemists when you were very young. Thus, you've decided to also fight the Alchemists independently. You are an Alchemist hunter, and you are determined to set things right. 

[h1]About Brandon[/h1]
Brandon is the brains of the game development operation. Although Adam and Brandon work together on the story and development of the game, its overall direction relies on Brandon's organized brain. Brandon does a fantastic job of pushing the development process where it needs to go. Brandon has a passion to make Lost Legend perfect, and he will push himself and others on the development team in the right direction until the project is complete.


[h1]About Adam[/h1]
Whereas Brandon is the brains of the game dev operation, Adam is the brains of the streaming operation. A content creator at heart, Adam has a now-dormant YouTube channel and writes music in his spare time. All the music in Lost Legend is written by Adam and many of the monotonous scenes in the game are pieced together by him. He is focused on increasing the production value of both Lost Legend and Unhinged LLC.


[h1]About Budda[/h1]
Firstly, his name. Budda is pronounced "Buddha," like the one we all know. It's a childhood nickname. Other than that, Budda generally loves the company of Adam and Brandon and provides an outside look at the game. Having no game dev experience, Budda asks questions that get Adam and Brandon's minds working and encourages problem solving and clairvoyance in the development process. He also loves interacting with the viewers and always watches the chat.

notes.title: Easter Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've just made an update to Lost Legend. A few things have changed:

[list]
[*] Kastburg is closer to completion. This city is proving to be very difficult for us to finish. For some reason, making progress on this city requires more motivation than other things on the game.
[*] Cephren Town has been updated. We've changed some graphics and made characters more lively. 
[*] The introduction has been scrapped and changed to one that better connects the player to our main character. 
[*] The option of a male protagonist, Kolton, is completely phased out once and for all: we've decided that our story's hero is female.
[*] A multitude of other small changes, like fixing spelling mistakes and such. 
[/list]

The game will remain [b]on sale until Sunday[/b] for those of you who still haven't purchased your copy. Thanks for everyone's support!

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.content: It has occurred to us that some of you may not be able to open the game. We are very sorry about this and we are putting out an update TODAY to fix this and add a few more features. We want your experience to be the very best with Lost Legend and we appreciate everyone that has already purchased the game. Thank you all and we hope to see some great feedback from the community.
